findings.title: Inconsistent parameter naming in findings_recall_percent
findings.body: The new function `findings_recall_percent` now delegates to `_percentage`, but its parameter is named `expected` while `_percentage` expects `total`. This breaks the naming consistency rule: the parameter should be renamed to `total` to match the helper's signature and the local convention of using `total` for denominators in percentage calculations.
